notes.title: HOTFIX FOR UPDATE 1.0.3 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Here are the notes for HOTFIX FOR UPDATE 1.0.3:

Level 11 and Level 12 (Controller related only)

  - Fixed an issue where you can't choose level 11 or level 12 with a controller from the world map.

Level 12 (Section 2 and Section 3)

  -Fixed an issue where Miko can't re-spawn if he fall off in the level.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Here are Patch 1.0.3 notes:

Level 4


 - Fixed a typo in the name of Level 4
 - Added 2 missing textures in some small areas
 - Fixed the Z-order of the slippery ice floor appearing behind other objects


Level 5


 - Fixed a monster behavior hidden behind a box where he does not move when the box is broken.
 - Edited the position of a snake and several boxes to avoid getting the snake stuck.
 - Edited the position of a monster that gets stuck behind a box.
 - Edited the tutorial sign that says "Follow the pipes"


Other:


 - Fixed the slow loading at the start of the game when it says the qoute (It was intended to be slow 
        like that but it is improved now to avoid confusion)
 - Changed the skip story button from "X" to "Y" to avoid confusion (Controller players)
 - Fixed a timer related bug (Controller players)
 - Fixed a bug when pressing options it opens up the credits immediately (Controller players)
 - Smoothed out the transition between parts in all levels
 - Fixed going into a portal sound fx not loading in properly in some cases
 - Made the "Press any key" in the loading at the start of the game to all caps "PRESS ANY KEY"
 - Fixed a bug where some links in the credits didn't work
 - Fixed a bug where the hitbox for links in the credits would appear when it should be hidden
 - Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would not be visible in credits
 - Fixed a typo at the end game
 - Fixed a typo in the credits


New:


 - Added an important warning at the start of level 1


I really hope you're having a good time with the game, I'm doing my best to give you all the best experience possible.

Thank you
Khaled,
Coriander Games

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Here is Patch 1.0.2 notes:

Level 7 (Progress bug)

(This bug is only related to Controller players)

 Fixed a Progress bug where no matter how many crystals you collect or how many medals you earn, level 8 never unlocks and level 7 don't register the medals you earned.

Level 1

 Edited a tutorial about Miko grabbing ledges to clarify exactly which ledges he could grab.

Other:

 Fixed a typo at the beginning of the game.

 Edited the following sound FX a bit (jumping - walking - landing on the floor - shooting fireball - grabbing ledge) as it was a bit bass heavy.

 Fixed a bug where the timer do not start in some levels and other times it will start randomly (Controller related only).

(Continue reading if you're using a controller)

This could result to unlock some timer based challenges without actually finishing them which of course takes the fun of the idea of doing and unlocking challenges.

You can continue playing the story as normal for sure but if you want to do the challenges as it was intended I highly recommend deleting your Save by doing the following.

Go to C:\Users\"Your username"\AppData\Roaming\Miko Adventures Puffball
And delete everything inside.

This will remove your save and you can play on a new save with no issues.

Really sorry about this issue, it should be fixed now.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Here is Patch 1.0.1 notes:

Level 2


   Edited the position of some diamonds.
   Edited some of the enemy positions.


Level 3


   Removed a spike as it was a bit challenging to get through.
   Increased the amount of health.
   Fixed a bug where Miko can bybass the green door without unlocking it.
   Removed the second greendoor when you pick up the green key as it has no purpose and was 
       from an old design.
   Optimization to parts in the level which makes run even better.


Level 4


   Increased the amount of health.
   Edit the size and position of an ice cube.


Level 7


   Edited a platform position.


Other:


   Fixed a controller related bug where you can't enter the challenges menu from the main menu.
   Fixed a bug where music from the start menu would run in the story scenes.
   Fixed a bug where some sound fx would continue to run in levels when pressing the skip button 
   from any story slide
   Fixed a bug in 2 story slides where it says continue/skip when it shouldn't.
   General optimization to the whole game.
   Other Minor fixes.
